items.title: Angola Talking Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: We used to play for Bob Knights up there, here in Louisiana. And, uh, we used to play at the River Road Inn. We played at Mr. Bob Knight's club.

ctx.x: His home was in, uh, in, uh, Cleveland, Mississippi. Mm-hmm. Well, he came to Greenville and got with us. And, uh, he asked us, would we see if we could scrap up a nice little band and make some dough. But we decided to scrap up. We went around and got boys and used to play in the band. They had quit. We went around and got together and made us a nice little orchestra. We used to play for Bob Knights up there, here in Louisiana. And, uh, we used to play at the River Road Inn. We played at Mr. Bob Knight's club.…
